comment: World (v) of the families round, light and charge (HIGHLIGHTS.md, Every family run on the engine and seen to work; the advisor's blinds, #1563 comment 5928483084; ALGEBRA.md rows (b), (f), (p), The content's index for every family, items 15 and 16): a packet of light, the holder of the sign's own record, along a tube onto a screen, its arrival the one measurement. The tube: x open with the faces' layer one Node deep and both x faces receding (`receding`, the source's return and what passes the screen leave the declared board), y and z periodic at `across` Nodes; one message of the charge family along +x at the wave number pi `wave`[0] / `wave`[1] per Link, the level `amplitude` at its top, the top the column x = `top` over the whole cross-section with a raised cosine of `edge` Nodes along x (the packet's own form sources the binding holder at the level weight 1, so its amplitude is kept under the two slits' 1,328: at 200 the lay's share rounds to no quantum at any Node and the count reads 0, at 600 about one quantum per Node of the top, the packet's own well a few hundred levels at the slab's centre, which slows the packet by its own index); the screen the column x = `screen` in `across` / `rows` regions of `rows` rows each across y and the whole ring across z (`screen_0` to `screen_3`, ordered along y; the loader's size rule, at least half the wavelength, q / p = 4 Nodes, across the beam on every axis of more than one Node, refuses a region of one row), backed by the receding face. One world on the universe of world (iv), examples/events/light_and_charge/charged.json (the rule's rows with the charged family): `free`, no body, laid by the builder with --modes (the free world's lay byte for byte the committed files on the engine of 2026-10-03). The two body worlds of the design as first written, `through_neutral` (a compact pixel of the matter family at the tube's centre) and `through_charged` (the same quanta of the charged family laid rotating), with the delay by the content's index as their blind, stood declared without a mode file and were removed on 2026-10-03 at the owner's word, what does not load is deleted; their blind and the readings of the earlier engines stand in the folder's blind_and_reading.md as history. Headless, `ticks` intervals; the reading by tools/click_counts.py against the blind, the clicks' arrival first. The run is not performed in the round that prepares it.
